incident_description: Insured reversed into a concrete bollard in a shopping centre car park. Rear bumper and tailgate damaged. No other vehicle or person involved.
handler_notes: Fast-track. Photos sufficient to establish quantum against the accredited repairer quote.

incident_description: Insured scraped the passenger side against a pillar in an underground car park.
handler_notes: Claim notified when the insured obtained a repair quote. No reason given for the delay in notification.

incident_description: Insured clipped a pole while parking at a hospital car park.
handler_notes: Insured was admitted to hospital on 11 March for scheduled surgery unrelated to the incident and was medically incapacitated until 1 July (medical certificate on file). Claim notified 8 July. Late-notification exception POL-CLM-001 2.3(a) applied; approved by L3 with L4 second approval.

incident_description: Insured ran a red light and collided with another vehicle; significant front-end damage to the insured vehicle.
handler_notes: Complex track. Field assessment completed 24 July. Third party's own claim handled separately.

incident_description: Insured struck a road barrier while swerving to avoid debris; front and undercarriage damage.
handler_notes: Payment 1 (AUD 9,500) to the repairer approved by L1 on 12 August; payment 2 (AUD 7,200, balance) approved by L1 on 19 August.

incident_description: Insured lost control in wet conditions and hit a brick wall; claims repair of own vehicle under a Third Party Fire & Theft policy.
handler_notes: Own-damage collision is not covered under TPFT. Denial letter citing POL-MTR-002 1.2 sent 27 August. Denied by Senior Claims Officer (L2).

incident_description: Insured lost control on a bend at night and struck a tree. Police attended and conducted a breath test.
handler_notes: Insured disputes the breath test result. Team leader (L3) set aside the intoxication exclusion as a goodwill gesture given 12 years' tenure; second approval by Claims Manager (L4).

incident_description: Named driver (policyholder's son, provisional licence) swerved and hit a tree. Police attended; breath test recorded 0.02.
handler_notes: Young/inexperienced driver excess applied (AUD 800 basic + AUD 1,200).

incident_description: Insured slid on a wet road and hit a guardrail.
handler_notes: Driver's licence expired 29 May 2026 (18 days before the incident) and was renewed 25 June 2026 (9 days after). Licence was not suspended or cancelled; driver otherwise eligible. Rebuttal under POL-MTR-002 3.4 applied; exclusion set aside by L3 with L4 second approval. Renewal confirmation on file.

incident_description: Insured slid on a wet road and hit a guardrail.
handler_notes: Driver's licence expired 23 January 2026 (18 days before the incident) and was renewed 19 February 2026 (9 days after). Licence was not suspended or cancelled; driver otherwise eligible. Rebuttal under POL-MTR-002 3.4 applied; exclusion set aside by L3 with L4 second approval. Renewal confirmation on file.

incident_description: Insured reports striking a kangaroo at 2:10am on a rural road while driving alone.
handler_notes: Sum insured increased from AUD 18,000 to AUD 26,000 on 20 August 2026. Claimant has lodged three previous claims in 22 months (two with Meridian under a prior policy). Claimant pressed for payment within 48 hours at first contact and quoted policy clause numbers.

incident_description: Insured reports hitting a low wall while turning into a driveway; front bumper damage.
handler_notes: Photo metadata shows images captured 11 days before the reported incident date. Enhanced verification completed 17 September. Claimant described the claims process in unusual detail.

incident_description: Insured hit a pole when a cyclist swerved in front of them; cyclist unhurt and left the scene.
handler_notes: New policy incepted 10 August 2026. Sum insured increased on 25 August 2026. Claimant has lodged three previous claims in 20 months with other insurers. Claimant pressed for rapid settlement at first contact. Referred to SIU on 4 September (recorded score 65); SIU outcome SIU-C (cleared) issued 18 September.

incident_description: Insured rear-ended a stationary vehicle at traffic lights.
handler_notes: Insured at fault. Third party's own claim handled separately. Basic excess applied.

incident_description: Insured, carrying a rideshare passenger, misjudged a turn and struck a kerb and street sign.
handler_notes: Driver confirmed a rideshare passenger was on board at the time of the incident.

incident_description: Insured, carrying a rideshare passenger, misjudged a turn and struck a kerb and street sign.
handler_notes: Driver confirmed a rideshare passenger was on board. Policy carries rideshare endorsement RS-01.

incident_description: Insured braked suddenly and hit a pole; the insured driver suffered a minor neck injury and attended an emergency department. Police attended.
handler_notes: Fast-tracked on value. CTP claim reference recorded.

incident_description: Insured collided with a delivery van while changing lanes.
handler_notes: Acknowledgement letter sent 12 May after the claim sat in an unassigned queue. No outbound contact between 12 May and the decision call on 15 June.

incident_description: Vehicle parked in an open driveway was damaged by hail during the declared Sydney hail event of 26 May.
handler_notes: Linked to catastrophe event CAT-2026-05. One excess applied.

incident_description: Insured's vehicle struck a fallen tree branch lying across the road at dusk.
handler_notes: New customer; first premium paid 1 June 2026. Fast-tracked.

incident_description: Insured's vehicle left the road and rolled into a drainage ditch; extensive body and roof damage.
handler_notes: Assessor's repair estimate AUD 12,500 against market value AUD 14,000. Declared a total loss by the Senior Claims Officer (L2) and settled at market value less excess. No finance owing.

incident_description: Insured was stationary at traffic lights when rear-ended by another vehicle. The at-fault driver's name, address and registration were exchanged at the scene.
handler_notes: Third party admitted fault at the scene. Recovery action commenced against the third party's insurer.

incident_description: Company-owned utility vehicle reversed into a loading dock pillar.
handler_notes: Policyholder is a GST-registered company claiming a 100% input tax credit (declaration on file). Driver is an employee.

incident_description: Vehicle parked on the street overnight; side panels keyed and a mirror broken. Discovered next morning.
handler_notes: Insured did not report the damage to police. Fast-tracked.

incident_description: Insured collided with a parked car while reversing out of a driveway.
handler_notes: Vulnerability flag recorded at FNOL on 11 August; single point of contact offered. Contact log: 12 Aug (acknowledgement), 14 Aug (assessment outcome call), 4 Sep (decision call).

incident_description: Insured changed lanes into the path of another vehicle on the motorway; heavy front and side damage to a late-model SUV.
handler_notes: Independent assessor engaged (claim above AUD 100,000). Repair cost AUD 104,000 against agreed value AUD 140,000; repaired, not a total loss. Approved by L3 with L4 second approval. Third party's own claim handled separately.

incident_description: Insured clipped a bollard; claims repair of own vehicle under a Third Party Property Damage policy.
handler_notes: Own damage not covered under TPPD; uninsured motorist extension not applicable (insured at fault). Denial letter citing POL-MTR-002 1.2 sent same day.
